amendment.summary: Added precondition check log-present (test -s logs/app.log) ahead of scan, with e-log-present-scan (pass) and e-log-present-no-log (fail) to a new stop node no-log (outcome halt); clarified scan's pass text so exit 1 is the clean fail and exit 2 is invalid-evidence.
amendment.reason: The scan's fail branch conflated 'no signals' with 'no log': a missing log made grep exit 2 with nothing printed, which the graph as written would end as a clean pulse. That is a false all-clear. The change only tightens: nothing reaches clean without the log having been read; no gate, approval, stop or critic isolation was removed or loosened. Hand-edited (grooph apply needed approval); grooph validate --for-export reports no issues.
